title: Fudge on the Bridge
lines: Meg has a box of fudge.
She runs it up to the bridge.
A big duck sits on the edge.
Meg stops. The duck will not move.
She steps to the side and slips.
The fudge lands on a big rock.
The duck hops up and licks it.
Mom hands Meg a badge for the best fudge.

questions.listenFor: On a big rock. Stated in the story - point them at that line rather than saying it for them.

questions.ask: Why did Meg step to the side?
questions.listenFor: The duck was on the edge of the bridge and would not move. If they say "she slipped," ask "what happened before that?"

questions.ask: Do you think Meg should get a badge if her fudge fell? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. Listen for a reason - she still made it, or the duck was not her fault.
